shots.focal_element: Oversized comment card with the typed request and a hand cursor pressing the Send button
on_screen_text: Make this a line graph instead?
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans card title in sentence case; regular-weight sans body for the request and button labels, normal tracking; font guess (low confidence): Anthropic Sans / a Styrene-like grotesk
shots.what_happens: A greatly magnified comment popover fills the frame; the hand cursor clicks Send and the request text dims to placeholder grey while the Discard and Queue buttons fade, signalling the comment was submitted.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a rounded white comment card scaled to about 2x over a flat slate background, place a hand-cursor sprite on the Send button, and on click tween the textarea text opacity from 1 to 0.4 and the secondary buttons to 0.6 over roughly 300 ms.

shots.focal_element: Bar chart on the right half of a traction slide morphing into a smoothed line graph
shots.transition_other: Cut/zoom out from the comment card to the slide canvas that the comment targeted (anchors: other)
on_screen_text: Sep Oct Nov Dec Jan Feb Mar Apr
shots.typography: Small all-caps tracked-out sans eyebrow and metric labels; large light serif display numerals for the hero stat and secondary metrics; light sans body; tiny sans chart labels
shots.what_happens: The slide's blue-selected chart panel answers the comment: the bars shrink from left to right into points as a line draws through them, ending as a smoothed line graph while the selection outline disappears; the pointer cursor stays still below.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a two-column slide (stat column left, chart panel right) and animate each bar's height down to a dot in a left-to-right stagger while an SVG path with stroke-dashoffset draws the line through the same data points.

shots.focal_element: Export dropdown menu in the top-right of the editor with the hand cursor moving down its items
shots.transition_other: Camera pulls back and reframes to the editor's top-right chrome (anchors: other)
shots.typography: Medium-weight sans menu items in sentence case with outline icons; black pill Export button with white label; Hemlark canvas uses a bold sans headline with the second line in an accent colour and a small all-caps tracked eyebrow
shots.what_happens: The cursor clicks Export, a dropdown with six export/handoff options opens, and the hover highlight steps down through PDF, PPTX and back up; mid-shot the canvas behind the open menu swaps from the traction slide to a Hemlark Retreat '26 event page while the menu stays fixed, showing the same export works across projects.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the editor chrome and an open dropdown pinned in place, move a hand cursor between menu rows with a light-grey hover fill, and crossfade the canvas content layer underneath from one project screenshot to another.

shots.focal_element: The same Export dropdown with hover moving to 'Export as standalone HTML' and then 'Handoff to Claude Code'
shots.transition_other: Content swap behind the fixed dropdown (canvas changes to a dark mobile-app project; anchors: other)
shots.typography: Same medium sans menu typography; the phone mockup uses a thin light sans for the large timer numerals and a small all-caps tracked label; tweak panel labels in regular sans
shots.what_happens: With the dropdown still open, the canvas shows a dark 'Now playing' phone mockup with a Tweaks panel, then switches to the dark interactive globe project as the hover moves to Export as standalone HTML and finally Handoff to Claude Code; the avatar initials also change between projects.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the pinned dropdown layer and step the hover highlight to the last two rows on beat while cutting the background canvas between two more project screenshots (phone app, then globe) every ~1 s.

shots.focal_element: 'Send to local coding agent' modal with a terminal-style command block and a Copy command button
on_screen_text: > Fetch this design file, read its readme, and implement the relevant aspects of the design. https://api.anthropic.com/v1/design/sp8Mp0D41yF?open_file=Interactive+globe.html
Give the agent more detail on what to implement (optional)
shots.typography: Segmented-tab sans labels (active tab bold); monospace text in a dark terminal block with macOS traffic-light dots and an italic filename; black pill button with white sans label; the background landing page uses a large serif headline
shots.what_happens: The full editor (chat pane left, globe landing page right) is shown dimmed under a handoff modal; the cursor clicks Copy command, then the modal closes to reveal the finished 'Every place has a story.' globe page.
shots.build_rebuild: Show the full app window with a semi-transparent scrim and a centered white modal containing tabs, a dark monospace code block and a Copy button; on click, fade the modal and scrim out over ~250 ms to reveal the page underneath.

shots.shot_type_other: Card-wall montage of many Claude Design project screenshots
shots.focal_element: Wall of editor-window thumbnails showing the range of projects made earlier in the video and more
shots.typography: Mixed per thumbnail: large serif editorial titles (The Quiet Disappearance, The Double Helix, Every place has a story.), light serif stat numerals, bold sans event headline; most thumbnail UI text is too small to read
shots.what_happens: The camera pulls far back into a staggered grid of about twenty project windows (editorial article, 3D terrain, dashboards, globe, traction slide, packaging, 3D trees scene, phone apps, aurora, DNA helix) with rows drifting slightly, recapping the breadth of what can be made.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out ~20 project screenshots as rounded soft-shadow cards in offset rows on a warm off-white background, zoom the camera out from one card into the full grid, and drift alternate rows horizontally a few percent in opposite directions.
